faqs.q: Sec. 1-7. - Provisions considered as continuation of existing ordinances.
faqs.a:
The provisions appearing in this and the following chapters and sections, so far as
               they are the same as those of the 1981 Code and ordinances or resolutions existing
               at the time of the adoption of this Code, shall be considered as a continuation and
               not as new enactments.
(Code 1960, § 1-6; Code 1981, § 1-4)
